name: Natural Justice
description: Principles of fair play including the right to a fair hearing and the rule against bias.

name: Presumption of Innocence
description: The legal principle that one is considered innocent until proven guilty.

name: Burden of Proof
description: The obligation to prove one's assertion. In criminal cases, this rests on the prosecution.

name: Mens Rea
description: The mental element of a person's intention to commit a crime; guilty mind.

name: Actus Reus
description: The physical act or conduct that constitutes the crime.

name: Reasonable Doubt
description: The standard of proof required in criminal cases for conviction.
